items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, p20 used for 1 µL and p300 for 50 µL, the 3x5 µL mix stays within the 11 µL well volume, and all labware is used as intended; the simulator ran clean.
Every plasmid and every SOC transfer uses its own pick_up_tip and drop_tip; the checks tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination all passed.
The code adds a mixing step (p20.mix(3, 5, ...)) that the paper does not describe and sets the lid to 42 C, an invented choice. It also has no return to 4 C between the shock and SOC addition.
The block is set to 4 C with the lid open, then 1 µL is aspirated from plasmid_plate[w] and dispensed into tc_plate[w] for A1-H1 with a fresh tip each time.
The lid is closed, then set_block_temperature(4, hold_time_minutes=30) and set_block_temperature(42, hold_time_seconds=30) run on the thermocycler.
50 µL SOC goes into each well with the p300 and a fresh tip, then the lid is closed and the block is held at 37 C for 60 min.

judge.summary: The protocol runs correctly: tip handling, volumes and the 4 C, 42 C and 37 C thermocycler steps all match the paper, and all measured checks passed. It fails fidelity because it adds an unspecified mixing step and uses a 42 C lid temperature the paper does not give.
